summary: News Corp filed an 8-K disclosing daily repurchase disclosures provided to the ASX under its $1 billion share buyback program. The program authorizes acquisition of Class A and Class B common stock from time to time; no per-share price, premium, or specific timeline is stated. The board previously authorized the program; no advisor is named. The filing fulfills ASX reporting requirements and includes forward-looking statements. The buyback is open-market with no fixed schedule, leaving the pace discretionary. Watch for ongoing repurchase rate disclosures in quarterly reports and any changes to market conditions affecting execution.
